from: August book, night 3 (The Work Starts Again)
p1: Heavenly Father’s people were building the Lord’s house. But some people nearby did not want it built. They made trouble until the work stopped.
For years and years, the Lord’s house sat unfinished.
Then the Lord sent two prophets, Haggai and Zechariah, to share His words. They cheered the builders on and helped them start again.
p2: The builders worked and worked. At last, the Lord’s house was finished! All the people came together to give it to the Lord. Their hearts were full of joy.
When something is hard, you can start again too. Heavenly Father will help you, one little step at a time. Tonight, think of one hard thing you will try again tomorrow.
old: Building the temple was not always easy. Some unkind neighbors tried to make the people stop, and for a while the work grew quiet and slow.
But two of Heavenly Father’s prophets, Haggai and Zechariah, cheered the people on. “Keep going!” they said. “Heavenly Father is with you!” So the people picked up their tools again.
A new king named Darius found King Cyrus’s old promise in the royal books. “Let them build!” Darius said. “And give them whatever they need.” What wonderful news!

Tap, tap, tap — the hammers sang, and higher and higher the temple rose, until at last it was finished! The people threw a joyful party to give the whole temple to Heavenly Father. He had helped them finish what they started, even when it was hard.
